actual_scope: Package the exact pricing, legality, retime, event-level retime, marginal and rank-r pricing tooling behind the P104 retime line as one command (tk) with a regression suite that reproduces the published numbers of PR5551, PR5553 and PR5561 and the retime PR5551 -> PR5561. No word and no kappa claim.
bottleneck_link: Retiming and paid-profile changes are only credible if the same exact invoice, legality replay and real-stack interval can be recomputed in seconds; this toolkit makes the paid-profile marginals (tk sens) and the retime freedoms (tk retime, tk evretime) reproducible and comparable on any P104-family word.
stop_rule: Keep the toolkit only if tests/regress.py reproduces every published number it wraps: exact kappa of PR5545/5551/5553/5561 and the starts-only word, localisation of three illegal mutants, the 5551 -> 5561 diff, the sens table, the PR5392 pricer results and the real-stack crossing intervals of PR5551, PR5553 and PR5561.
